Native-safe search history (replaces L15-21 import + the localStorage logic the import pulled in): SEARCH_HISTORY_CAP=12 / MIN_QUERY_LEN=2 / DEFAULT_RETURN=8 and the HistoryEntry {q,ts} shape match searchHistory.ts exactly; recordSearch (trim, min-len guard, case-insensitive dedup, newest-first, slice to CAP), getRecentSearches (clamp 0..min(max,CAP)), removeSearch (case-insensitive filter, delete-scope-when-empty), and clearScope reproduce the source functions over a module-level Map<scope,entries[]> instead of a localStorage envelope. The load/save/JSON-resilience layer is unnecessary in-memory and omitted; the only behavioural delta (no persistence across app restarts) is documented here as the explicit unavailable state.

i18n fallback: react-i18next has no native module, so useTranslation() returns a t that resolves the inline English fallback and interpolates {{token}} params via interpolate() (regex /\{\{\s*(\w+)\s*\}\}/g), matching the ChartContainer/ReauthDialog ports; every i18n key is preserved (common.clear, search.history.title, search.history.removeAria, search.history.clear). No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components are imported (rule 4): only React, react-native primitives (Pressable, ScrollView, StyleSheet, TextInput, View, type-only NativeSyntheticEvent/StyleProp/TextInputKeyPressEventData/ViewStyle), the existing apps/native AppText primitive, and the shared theme colors/shadows/spacing tokens (rule 5). Verified gates from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit) passes, npm run lint -- --quiet passes (0 errors), and npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles passes.
